what: Draws the text held in each column (col) onto a canvas as a 10px fixed-width uppercase grid — each cell pulls a letter from a different spot using three layers of simplex noise, the top row stays as is, and further down it scatters by (y share)² times up to ±3600px horizontally and ±1800px vertically, with the noise drifting .1 per second so it shimmers nonstop (strength 1.5~4 times per cell). Hovering over a column turns that column and the letters pulled from it to the accent color, and rolling the horizontal scroll panel (scroller) or dragging with the mouse moves the column strip (track) and the grid together — releasing within 3px goes to that column’s link

options.line: Line height (multiple of font size), default 1.3
options.amp: Scatter strength (px), default 1800 — width is twice that. 0 means no scatter
options.speed: Speed multiplier for the flowing noise, default 1. 0 leaves a frozen, scattered pattern
options.gutter: Column left margin (px), default 10.4 — text starts at column left plus margin
options.seed: Noise seed (0~1). If omitted, random on every open (as in the original)
options.[data-fx-part=col]: Text column — position and width come from the consumer’s css (measured by offsetLeft and offsetWidth). Hover adds .is-hot. data-href or an inner a[href] is the press link
options.[data-fx-part=text]: Original text inside the pillar (hidden on screen) — if none, the pillar’s data-text
options.[data-fx-part=canvas]: Canvas to draw on (position and size via consuming css). If absent, it is created at the front of the part
options.[data-fx-part=track]: Panel holding the pillars — translateX by the scroll amount
options.[data-fx-part=scroller]: Horizontal scroll panel (optional) — its scrollLeft pushes the grid and panels

from.where: index.html body canvas under the text column (noisejs simplex3 · j=[1800,1600])

note: The grid is fixed-width, one character per cell, so Korean (two cells wide) overlaps — use Latin text. With many columns it is cells × three noise calls, so a full screen (240×50 cells) means 36,000 per frame — on large screens, if it is heavy, set amp·speed to 0. Devices without a pointer get scrolling only, without the accent color
